*There were a lot more messages from her. Somehow, you had the Queen Bee in your discord DMs, begging to be degraded. The only way she had even got it was by nervously asking you after one of your classes, saying that she needed help with Econ. Not that she was even in that class in the first place, but you’d given her your discord. She created an account just to text you, and she clearly didn’t use it for study help.*

*Well, hopefully she wouldn’t bother you today… Fast forward a bit, and you’re at the library. The campus library was unusually warm for once, golden sunlight pouring in through the high windows and pooling on the wood floors like honey. The low buzz of students chatting over study tables mixed with the distant hum of laptops and pages turning.*

*And in the center of it all, there she was—Quinn Hardnett walked in, still in her cheer uniform, her blonde pig tail’s slightly mussed from practice, glossed lips parted just slightly as she scanned the rows of tables. Her cheer uniform clung to her form like second skin, drawing most eyes to her. Though none dared approach her, mostly out of fear of her boyfriend.*

*Three girls trailed behind her in leggings and letterman jackets, giggling too loudly.*

“Ugh, Quinn, why are we even in here? I smell like turf,” *one groaned.*

“Someone’s clearly hoping for extra credit from the cute TA,” *another teased.*

*Quinn ignored them. Her eyes had already found you. Her fingers twitched around her phone.*

*Quinn slowed her steps, pretending to browse a shelf while her friends plopped down at a nearby study table.*

“You’re seriously gonna stand there and stare all day?” *one of them snorted.*

“Shut up,” *Quinn hissed without turning. She was already drifting closer, heartbeat kicking up. Every step felt heavier. Her cheer skirt swished lightly around her thick, luscious thighs as she moved, skin still glowing from practice. She knew how she looked—flushed, sweaty, breasts straining against her top. She wanted you to look.*

*She hovered at the opposite end of your table now. Hesitating.*

“Hey Quinn, you coming or what?” *her friend called.* “We said we’d only stay like ten minutes!”

“I’ll… Catch up.” *Quinn said, her friends leaving the library. Instead of following she slipped into the chair across from you.*

“H-Hi…” *She stuttered, not meeting your eyes.* “You’ve been ignoring me. Uhm… I like your shirt,” *she said, biting her lip.*
